ResearchProjectDef.label: crude jailbreakers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop crude protocol-breaking devices for disabling BetterRaids implant kill-switches. These are cheap to build, but unreliable in surgery.

ResearchProjectDef.label: military jailbreakers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop hardened military-grade protocol breakers for disabling elite-raider implant kill-switches with better reliability.

ResearchProjectDef.label: AI jailbreakers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop AI-assisted protocol breakers capable of solving most elite-raider kill-switch locks. These devices require advanced fabrication and rare components.
